title: Rotational coverage sparkline — one-off availability & asks (Apr 2035)
body:

Columns:

Samir Patel | customer-success | apac | samir@redwood.ai | Jenna Lopez | 2.5 | 60% | Wed 09-13 | 9 | ▂▃▂▃▂▃▂ | Customer touchpoints on Wed; wants handoff doc template
Aisha Rahman | serving-runtime | us-west | aisha@redwood.ai | TBD | 3.0 | 66% | M/W/F 16-20 | 25 | ▃▅▄▅▅▃▄ | Raising capacity concern for peak inference window; request: short-term burst reservation
TBD | sre | global | oncall-sre@redwood.ai | TBD | 2.0 | 50% | Rotating nightly 00-04 | 20 | ▁▁▁▂▁▁▁ | SRE slot needs owner; possible swap with infra for Apr 18

Quick take (one-paragraph):
This lightweight grid is a rapid, cross-functional capture of who can cover short-term operational windows during the Apr 15-21 patch and rollout. We prioritized people who are already aligned with the feature roll (serving-runtime, infra, observability) and added CS and SE for customer-facing handoffs. Sparklines reflect weekly availability trend (visual heuristic) not exact calendar blocks. Micro-econ delta is a back-of-envelope estimate of incremental cost/hour if we add a paid burst or contractor coverage — used for quick trade-offs.

Assumptions and caveats:
- Availability % is self-reported and rounds to nearest 5%.
- Micro-econ delta assumes contractor rate $120/hr baseline; internal uplift is opportunity cost (not direct billing).
- Tentative shifts are subject to final confirmation in Slack thread #ops-coverage and Jira JIRA-33421.
- This sheet is intentionally compact; for formal rota we will import into the rota spreadsheet and push calendar invites.

Immediate asks (action owners and ETA):
- [Priya] Confirm backups for Priya/Miguel shifts by EOD Apr 12 (Slack ping).
- [Miguel] Approve one 2-hour burst reservation for Apr 16 09:00 UTC — reply on JIRA-33421 by Apr 13.
- [Olivia] Share temporary SSO token request steps with Daniel by Apr 12; add access checklist to Confluence page.
- [Aisha] Provide a short runbook (one page) for handling inference throttles during the rollout; draft due Apr 13.
- [Product-ops] Convert to calendar invites and publish final rota by Apr 14 18:00 PDT.

Risk scoreboard (fast):
- High: Serving-runtime peak (if unreserved burst denied) — mitigation: approve one 2-hr burst (Miguel/Aisha).
- Medium: Observability trace gaps Tue morning — mitigation: Olivia to run sampling + SRE to hold local logs for 72hrs.
- Low: CS handoff delays — mitigation: provide customer one-pager and template (Samir).

Next checks and cadence:
- Standup quick-check in #ops-coverage Apr 13 10:30 PDT (15 min).
- Final handoff confirmation Apr 14 17:00 PDT.
- Post-rollout mini-retro Apr 22 (capture learnings into Confluence page linked above).

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- If Miguel can't take Apr 16, consider external contractor (budget confirm with finance, quick approval via JIRA-33211).
- Keep this one-off sheet available as an importable CSV template for future short-sprint rollouts.
- Add column next iteration: "Required IAM perms" and "Calendar invite id" to reduce friction.

End of snapshot.
